description_en: Queries sub-division addresses based on the division code
description_zh: 根据区划码查询子区划地址
kebab_example: aliyun linkedmall query-child-division-code-by-id --distributor-id example-string --division-code 110000 --tenant-id example-string --api-version 2022-05-31 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryChildDivisionCodeById

parameters.help_en: The ID of the distributor that initiates the query
parameters.help_zh: 分销商 ID，用于标识发起查询的分销商
parameters.name: distributor_id

parameters.help_en: The division code of the area whose sub-areas you want to query. The server converts this code to a number to query the sub-areas
parameters.help_zh: 要查询其下级区域的区域编码；服务端将其转换为数字后查询子级区域
parameters.name: division_code

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant to which the request belongs
parameters.help_zh: 租户 ID，用于标识请求所属租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

schema.description_en: The list of sub-areas for the specified area and the request processing result
schema.description_zh: 返回指定区域的下级区域列表及请求处理结果

Code.description_en: The service execution result code. The area query service returns SUCCESS when the request is processed successfully
Code.description_zh: 服务执行结果码；区域查询服务成功处理时返回 SUCCESS
Code.title_en: 返回的执行结果码， 正确为字符串 0000
Code.title_zh: 返回的执行结果码， 正确为字符串 0000

LogsId.title_zh: 每次请求操作对应的操作日志号，由系统自动生成，返回给租户，可用于排查问题，双方日志中统一透出此标识

Message.description_en: The service execution result message. The error cause is returned when an error occurs

Model.description_en: The result data of the sub-area query
Model.description_zh: 下级区域查询的结果数据

DivisionList.description_zh: 查询到的下级区域列表

ParentId.description_en: The code of the parent area
